end.summary:
Practised identifying solids from top, front and side views.
Matched views to objects correctly in all 4 matching attempts.
Answered 2 of 5 view-description attempts without help.
Discussed circles, rectangles and triangles for cones, cylinders, cups and cubes.
A mix-up about showing an object's handle was noted.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing what can be seen from the top, front and side, using visible shapes such as circles, rectangles and triangles. Matching a view to the correct object went well, especially when they explained features like a cone’s slanting sides and a cylinder’s straight sides. There was a mix-up about including a cup’s handle when it was not visible from that viewpoint, and this was not marked as corrected after the last time it appeared. At home, show a cup, box or cone from different positions and ask, “What can you see from here?”
